bootstrap.estimand: Unique-case mean FULL margin +8-minus-+7; paired group mean differences
bootstrap.sampling_unit: case_id; shared resample of the case union, retaining group memberships
bootstrap.limitations: Exploratory percentile intervals; small, selected case sample; not a seed-level or causal test.

limitations: EOS excluded by default: scores are prefix likelihoods, not probabilities of complete terminated answers.
Candidate lengths differ; sums and token means answer different questions.
Shared-prefix probabilities contribute to both sums; paths are scored separately after branching.
Joint text tokenization may differ; audit flags do not change the explicit constrained-candidate token path.
A failed prompt decode/re-encode roundtrip makes the joint-text audit inconclusive.
Teacher forcing follows prescribed candidates; it is not greedy/constrained generation behavior.
Logits are scored with full-vocabulary softmax, without candidate-only renormalization.
Full-sequence no-cache computation may differ numerically from branch-only or cached execution.
Case margins are reused across seeds; slot summaries are descriptive, not independent replicates.
Different input_protocol values are distinct experimental conditions, never repeated measurements.
Legacy diagnostic_compatible branch margins are reference-only for behavior_compatible runs; no numeric equivalence test is performed.
Case overlap across groups is retained by the shared case bootstrap; intervals are exploratory.
Previous branch CSVs may cover only six cases; missing branch data are not imputed.
Branch token metadata must match before numerical comparison; CSVs alone cannot prove prompt equivalence.
Length effects and missing EOS can change full-margin signs without a corresponding greedy label change.
